descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# vJourney – Guided Virtual Travel for Everyone

Experience virtual travel in a new and immersive way.
With vJourney, you can explore real destinations through high quality 360° environments. Move freely through each location and switch between places at any time using the navigation arrows. Discover the world at your own pace and follow your own path.

**Virtual Travel Book and Audio Tour Guide** 

Dive deeper into every destination with the virtual travel book.
Discover culture, history, and landmarks through immersive storytelling, narrated by your personal audio tour guide. Each location reveals its deeper meaning as you explore the stories behind what you see.
Whenever you choose, you can seamlessly close the book with a single click and enjoy the full 360° view, completely unobstructed.
[media]
**Image Galleries**

In selected destinations, you can access additional image galleries.
Explore more perspectives, details, and impressions that go beyond the main experience and give you a broader view of each location.


[media]

**Interactive 3D Elements**

Enhance your journey with interactive 3D elements.
Discover objects within the environment, pick them up, and explore them from every angle to better understand the details of each scene.
[media]
